subject: FalconPay enablement — split API & Console lab / calendar sync
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Alex Li <alex.li@falconpay.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FalconPay: proposed two-part enablement (Console + API)

Hi Alex / Ben / Tessa,

Thanks again for the time earlier this week. To keep the enablement focused and measurable, I propose a two-part delivery: a Console walkthrough (UI, RBAC, telemetry) followed by an API deep-dive + hands-on lab (tokens, batching, KV cache). Details below:

- Proposed format: two 90-minute blocks (recorded)
  - Session A — Console walkthrough, admin & ops: 60m demo + 30m Q&A
  - Session B — API deep-dive and hands-on lab: 30m arch + 60m guided lab
- Goals: production-time onboarding, SSO check, preflight access validation, sample prompts for the lab
- Suggested windows (pick one):
  1) Tue Aug 11, 13:00–14:30 PT (covers US & APAC early hours)
  2) Fri Aug 14, 09:00–10:30 PT (better for EU attendees)

Attachments: falconpay-enable-agenda.pdf (agenda + preflight checklist)

Can you confirm preferred window and an attendee count per region? Tessa, can you take point on the calendar blocks and ICS invites if we lock dates?

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@falconpay.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Aug 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FalconPay: proposed two-part enablement (Console + API)

On Fri, Aug 3, 2028 at 9:12 AM Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the time earlier this week. To keep the enablement focused...

Alex — either window works from our side, but to reduce churn I'd prefer a single contiguous plan where possible. Two quick asks before we lock:

1) How many engineers & product folks will join each session (approx)?
2) Do you require the session to be recorded and shared internally only, or posted to your LMS?
3) Any SSO / SAML gotchas we should anticipate (IdP name, test account list)?

Tessa — if they pick Aug 11 I can take the Console session lead and loop Camila into the lab. If Aug 14 we should flip ownership (Camila lead).

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Alex Li <alex.li@falconpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@falconpay.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Aug 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FalconPay: proposed two-part enablement (Console + API)

Hi team,

Thanks — Aug 11, 13:00–14:30 PT works best for our US folks. For the EU engineers, Aug 14 mid-morning CEST would be better; happy to do two split sessions. Recording is fine (internal use only).

Attendee rough counts: US — 6 engineers, 3 product; EU — 4 engineers, 2 product. We'll send a finalized attendee list; attaching current guest list.

Preflight note: we do have an IdP (Okta) — I'll add the test accounts in the attached CSV and flag any conditional MFA policies to expect.

Attachments: FalconPay_guest_list.csv

Appreciate the split approach if that helps schedule folks across regions.

— Alex
Alex Li
Head of Integrations | FalconPay
alex.li@falconpay.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@falconpay.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Aug 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FalconPay: proposed two-part enablement (Console + API)

Thanks Alex — splitting makes sense. Proposed final cadence:

- Session 1 (US/APAC): Tue Aug 11, 13:00–14:30 PT — Console walkthrough + ops Q&A
- Session 2 (EU): Fri Aug 14, 17:00–18:30 CEST (09:00–10:30 PT) — API deep-dive + hands-on lab

Preflight checklist (please complete 48h before session):
- Add these test accounts to your Okta dev app (CSV provided)
- Confirm SAML attributes (email, name, groups) and send the metadata xml if different from standard
- Provide sample dataset (anonymized) for lab tokenization (optional but helpful)
- Confirm who will own session notes / recording distribution

I've provisionally created two ICS invites and set them to "tentative" so they appear on calendars. When you confirm attendee list and SSO metadata I'll convert to confirmed and send final calendar invites.

Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.com

All set — locking in final schedule per Tessa's plan. Summary & next steps: 

- Confirmed sessions:
  • Aug 11, 13:00–14:30 PT — Console walkthrough (US/APAC)
  • Aug 14, 09:00–10:30 PT — API deep-dive (EU)
- I created the HubSpot activity and linked the calendar events: https://hubspot.com/deals/FP-2028-1183
- Delivery pack attached: enablement-pack.zip (slides, runbook, preflight checklist); session ICSs attached as session-ics.ics
- Alex: please send the finalized attendee CSV and Okta metadata by Wed Aug 9 so we can validate SSO before the lab

Thanks everyone — we'll send final confirmed invites once the CSV + metadata are in. Looking forward to it.
